newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Graphics says new products enthuse.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Graphics says new products enthuse.

text.p: Silicon Graphics Chief Executive Edward McCracken said that, despite the company's financial shortfall in its first fiscal quarter, customers are "extremely enthusiastic" over its new product offerings.

The company reported a net loss for the quarter after several special charges, of $22 million or a $0.13 per-share loss, compared with net income of $58 million, or a $0.33 a share profit, in the year-ago first quarter.
Ten days ago, the company introduced a sweeping revamping of its product lines with new models ranging from new, inexpensive desktops to high-end supercomputers.

"Our customers are extremely enthusiastic, as this new architecture gives them the basis for everything from the most powerful desktop and deskside Web servers to highly scalable mid-range departmental servers and enterprise-wide database engines to scalable supercomputers," McCraken said in a statement issued with the earnings report.
McCracken reiterated a statement last month that delays in orders to customers awaiting the new products had been a significant reason behind the earnings shortfall.
Silicon Graphics last month warned investors that its first quarter revenues would be roughly flat sequentially.
